tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The open sky everything floats on.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, menus and dialogs that sit on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Insets: code blocks, DNS record views, query logs, table headers.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes, toggles and other controls. Meets 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, and the logo bird in Day, on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and `sky-soft`. In Night it is the bird's color too.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, helper text, table metadata, on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Identity tint: hero blocks, empty states and large illustration fields. Not for text; set text on it in `on-sky`.

tokens.name: on-sky
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `sky` block.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active nav items and info panels. Pair with `ink` or `sky-strong` text.

tokens.name: sky-strong
tokens.usage: The interactive color: links, primary buttons, toggles in the on state, the active cluster node. Text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and `sky-soft`.

tokens.name: on-sky-strong
tokens.usage: Label text and icons on a `sky-strong` fill (primary buttons).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status: healthy, in sync, resolver online. Always with a word or icon. Text on `ok-soft`, `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an `ok` status badge.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Status: degraded, lagging replica, list update overdue. Always with a word or icon. Text on `warn-soft`, `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a `warn` status badge.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Status: node down, anomaly, device quarantined. Always with a word or icon. Text on `alert-soft`, `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: alert-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an `alert` status badge.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring, 2px outside the element. At least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: flock-1
tokens.usage: Device group color 1 (sky), fixed order. Group tags, chart series and node markers; always beside the group's name.

tokens.name: flock-2
tokens.usage: Device group color 2 (tangerine), fixed order.

tokens.name: flock-3
tokens.usage: Device group color 3 (plum), fixed order.

tokens.name: flock-4
tokens.usage: Device group color 4 (leaf), fixed order.

tokens.name: flock-5
tokens.usage: Device group color 5 (rose), fixed order. A sixth group and beyond fold into `flock-other`.

tokens.name: flock-other
tokens.usage: Neutral for "Other": every group past five, and ungrouped devices.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: hero lines and empty-state headlines.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles and table group headers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: kitchen-tablet asked for ads.example.net and got 0.0.0.0, because it's on the Kids list.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells, helper text, dense panels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, form labels, badges, nav items.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Domain names, IPs, MACs, DNS records and anything a user might copy.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Inline record metadata and query-log details.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control, between related chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding and form-field spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards; section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero and empty-state breathing room. Be generous: air is part of the brand.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, hero panels, the app icon's corner at 96px.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, toggles, avatars and node dots.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Raised cards, menus and dialogs. The only shadow: things float, they don't stack.
